data.title: Rejection of Landscape Protection Exemption for a Boat Dock
data.summary: Kreis Nordmuster (Fachdienst Naturschutz) rejects Merle Beispielsen's application of 12 June 2025 for an exemption from the Landscape Protection Ordinance (Landschaftsschutzverordnung) "Mustersee-Niederung" to build a 14-metre wooden boat dock, citing protected bird breeding and resting habitat and the conditions of § 67 BNatSchG not being met.
data.explanation: The county (Kreis) has refused your request to build a boat dock at your shoreline property because the area is a protected breeding and resting habitat for birds within a landscape protection zone, and the legal requirements for an exemption under § 67 BNatSchG are not fulfilled. If you disagree with this decision, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Kreis; the app will show the deadline based on when the letter is considered delivered. If you take no action, the rejection becomes final and the dock may not be built. Since this concerns nature conservation law, consulting a lawyer specialising in administrative or environmental law may help if you want to contest it.

key_facts.label: Legal basis for the exemption requirement (Rechtsgrundlage)
key_facts.quote: Eine Befreiung nach § 67 BNatSchG ist nur möglich, wenn überwiegende öffentliche Interessen sie erfordern oder das Verbot im Einzelfall zu einer unzumutbaren Belastung führt; beides liegt nicht vor.
